discription: A percussive, bell-like sound created using FM synthesis with a short, decaying envelope and evolving timbre.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, carMul=1, modMul=1.5, modIdx=5;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.001, 0.4, 0.0, 0.1, curve: -4),         gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var carrierFreq = freq * carMul;    var modulatorFreq = freq * modMul;    var modulator = SinOsc.ar(modulatorFreq) * (modulatorFreq * modIdx * env);    sig = SinOsc.ar(carrierFreq + modulator);    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
